name: AffixLengthMismatch
message: This substring cuts a different number of characters than the prefix or suffix the code has just tested, so the result keeps a piece of the affix or loses a character of the value (path.startsWith("file://") then path.substring(6) keeps a slash; a quoted string cut with substring(1, s.length() - 2) loses its last character). The code runs and returns a value that is off by one. Cut exactly what was tested: path.substring("file://".length()), s.substring(1, s.length() - 1), or keep the affix in a constant that both the test and the cut use. Right code is not reported: an offset taken from the literal ("file://".length()), an offset equal to the tested length, and a prefix followed by another test of the same value, such as a separator check.

message: This annotation attribute is used as it is, while other attributes of the same annotation instance in this method go through resolve(...), resolveEmbeddedValue, resolveStringValue, resolvePlaceholders or evaluate(...). A property placeholder or SpEL expression in its value is then taken literally. Resolve it like its siblings: endpoint.setConsumes(resolve(listener.consumes())). An attribute that is meant to be literal (a class name, an id) can stay raw; then read it before the resolved ones or pass it to a method that documents it as literal.

Assert.notNull(name, "name must not be null") on its own is fine.

An exception fits when the source always completes on a pool made for blocking work.

name: BufferNeverReleased
xpath:
let $allocators := ('buffer', 'directBuffer', 'heapBuffer', 'ioBuffer', 'compositeBuffer', 'compositeDirectBuffer'),
    $reads := '^(get|set|read|write|is|has|can|skip|index|bytes|ensure|capacity|readable|writable|equals|hashCode|toString|refCnt|clear|mark|reset|order|max|forEach|compareTo)',
    $fluent := '^(write|set|clear|mark|reset|skip|ensure|discard)',
    $shares := 'Slice|Retained|Duplicate|Sink|Readonly',
    $allocates := function($init) {
      exists($init[self::MethodCall]
        [(@MethodName = $allocators
          and (*[1][self::MethodCall][@MethodName = 'alloc']
               or *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBufAllocator')]
               or *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('io.netty.buffer.Unpooled')][../@MethodName = 'directBuffer']))
         or (@MethodName = ('retain', 'readRetainedSlice', 'retainedSlice', 'retainedDuplicate') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf')])
         or (matches(@MethodName, '^encode') and pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf'))])
    },
    $onlyRead := function($u) {
      ($u/parent::MethodCall[*[1] is $u][matches(@MethodName, $reads)][not(matches(@MethodName, $shares))]
         [parent::ExpressionStatement or not(matches(@MethodName, $fluent))])
      or ($u/parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('equals', 'compareTo', 'writeBytes', 'setBytes')])
    }
return
  //LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator
    [VariableId[pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf')]]
    [$allocates(*[2])]
    [let $name := VariableId/@Name, $scope := ancestor::Block[1]
     return every $u in $scope//VariableAccess[@Name = $name] satisfies $onlyRead($u)]
message: This reference-counted buffer is allocated, retained or encoded here and only read in the method: it is never released, returned, stored or handed to another call, so its memory (direct memory for pooled Netty buffers) leaks until the process runs out. Release it on every path: a try block with buf.release() in its finally, or hand it to the pipeline (ctx.write(buf)) or return it. An exception fits an unpooled heap buffer, which the garbage collector frees.

return
  //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[(@SimpleName = 'Cacheable' and not(.//BooleanLiteral[@True = false()]))
                                            or @SimpleName = 'Cache']]
    [ancestor::CompilationUnit/ImportDeclaration[@ImportedName = ('jakarta.persistence.Cacheable', 'javax.persistence.Cacheable',
                                                               'org.hibernate.annotations.Cache')]]
    /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('static', 'transient'))]
      [ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = $mappings]]
      [not(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Transient'])]
      [let $unit := ancestor::CompilationUnit,
           $type := *[self::ClassType or self::ArrayType][1]

message: This mapped field of a second-level cached entity (@Cacheable or Hibernate @Cache) holds a project type that is not Serializable (or a collection of them). A cache that serializes entries (Ehcache with off-heap or disk tiers, a distributed cache) throws NotSerializableException on the write, or skips the entry, while tests with an in-memory cache pass. Make the type implement Serializable (public abstract class Attribute implements Serializable), mark the field @Transient or transient, or cache the entity with a JSON serializer. An exception fits a cache that keeps entries by reference.

name: CachedFutureKeepsFailure
xpath:
//ClassDeclaration/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()]
  [ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture')]]
  [let $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name,
       $body := ancestor::ClassBody[1],
       $handlers := $body//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('whenComplete', 'exceptionally', 'handle', 'whenCompleteAsync', 'handleAsync')],
       $resetters := ($handlers//MethodCall/@MethodName | $handlers//MethodReference/@MethodName),
       $assigned := $body//AssignmentExpression[*[1][(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]]
   return exists($assigned[*[2][not(self::NullLiteral)]])
     and empty($assigned[*[2][self::NullLiteral]][ancestor::LambdaExpression or ancestor::CatchClause or ancestor::FinallyClause
                                           or ancestor::MethodDeclaration[@Name = $resetters]])
     and exists($body//InfixExpression[@Operator = ('==', '!=')][*[(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]][NullLiteral])
     and exists($body//ReturnStatement[*[1][(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]
                                       or *[1][self::ConditionalExpression]/*[(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]])
     and empty($body//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'compareAndSet'][*[1][(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $name]])]
message: This field caches a CompletableFuture and later calls return it, but nothing ever resets it after a failure, so a first attempt that fails is replayed to every later caller instead of being retried. Reset the field when the attempt fails, and only if it still holds this attempt: future.whenComplete((value, error) -> reset(future, error)), or keep the future in an AtomicReference and call compareAndSet(future, null). An exception fits only when keeping the first failure is intended.

message: This method of a shared component (a singleton Spring bean, a servlet or a filter) stores a value built from its own argument in an instance field. An exception fits a one-time lazy initialisation that is meant to latch the first value; do it in an init method instead.

name: ChangeNamedEquality
message: A name that says something changed is computed as plain equality: isModified() or a hasChanged variable holds a.equals(b), so it is true exactly when nothing differs. A settings page then never offers Apply, or listeners fire on every refresh except real changes, and the code still compiles. Negate the comparison (return !current.equals(initial);, boolean hasChanged = !Objects.equals(saved, edited);), or rename the method or variable to say what it tests (isUnchanged). An exception fits a name that says the values match.

Convert once where the value enters (TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMillis(seconds), Duration.ofSeconds(seconds).toMillis() or seconds * 1000) and name the result with its unit; if a name gives the wrong unit, rename it to the real one.

name: MkdirsResultAsFailure
message: File.mkdirs() and File.mkdir() return false when the directory already exists, also when another thread or process created it a moment ago, so treating false as a failure throws under concurrent writers. Use Files.createDirectories(dir.toPath()), which does not fail for an existing directory, or if (!dir.mkdirs() && !dir.isDirectory()) throw new IOException(...). An exception fits when the directory was just deleted or has a fresh random name.

name: NewlineOnlyLineSplit
message: This splits text read from a file on "\n" only, so every line of a CRLF file keeps a trailing carriage return, comparisons and regular expressions are off, and text that uses a lone carriage return is not split at all. Split on every line terminator with split("\\R") or lines(), or read it line by line with a BufferedReader. Text the program generated itself is fine.

name: OptionalOrElseGetNull
message: orElseGet(null) passes a null Supplier: it compiles, but throws a NullPointerException as soon as the Optional is empty. Use orElse(null) when a null result is meant (and check it where it is used), orElseGet(() -> fallback()) for a computed default, or orElseThrow(() -> new NotFoundException(id)) when absence is an error.

name: PlainCollectionInConcurrentMap
message: A value of this concurrent map is a plain collection (ArrayList, HashSet, HashMap and the like) that is changed after computeIfAbsent returns it, so two threads that add under the same key change it at once: elements are lost, a reader throws ConcurrentModificationException and a HashMap can corrupt. Store a concurrent value (ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet(), CopyOnWriteArrayList, new ConcurrentHashMap<>()), change it inside compute or merge, or lock around every read and write of the value. An exception fits a map that only one thread uses.

//(ClassDeclaration | RecordDeclaration | EnumDeclaration | MethodDeclaration | ConstructorDeclaration | CompactConstructorDeclaration)
  /ModifierList/Annotation[contains(@SimpleName, 'Generated')]
message: Remove the annotation from hand-written code: JaCoCo skips code carrying an annotation whose name contains Generated, and PIT skips @Generated, so this is not measured. Put the JPA @GeneratedValue on the field.

name: InconsistentFieldLocking
message: This write of a field holds no lock, while another write of the same field in the class holds one: a thread that writes here races with the locked writer, so an update is lost or another thread sees a stale value. Hold the lock the locked write holds for every write of the field (synchronized on the same monitor, or lock() and unlock() of the same Lock), or make the field an atomic or concurrent type (AtomicLong, LongAdder, ConcurrentHashMap). Constructors, initializers, a single write of a volatile field, a write in a lambda and a method the class calls while it holds a lock are not reported.

name: LockOrderInversion
message: This nesting takes two locks of the class in the opposite order to another nesting of the class: two threads that run both can each hold one lock and wait forever for the other, a deadlock that no test reliably shows. Take nested locks in one order everywhere in the class (if any path takes a and then b, no path takes b and then a), or guard the state with one lock. Only locks held in fields of the class, this, Type.class and Type.FIELD are compared; a lock passed in, held in a local or taken in a called method is not followed.

name: LogExceptionFirst
message: Pass the exception first (log.errorf(e, "Cannot read %s", path)), or e.getMessage() when only the text is wanted. After the format, JBoss Logging never logs its stack trace.

name: LogFormatArguments
message: Pass one argument per placeholder, in the method''s own syntax: %s for printf methods (JBoss Logging infof, Log4j 2 printf and formatter loggers), '{'0} for MessageFormat methods (JBoss Logging infov, java.util.logging log), with '''' for an apostrophe there. Keep the format a constant. Otherwise values are dropped or the call throws.

name: LogStringConcatenation
xpath:
//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'config', 'warning', 'severe')]
  [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder')
    or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger')
    or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log')]]
  /ArgumentList/(*[1] | *[1][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String'))]/following-sibling::*[1])
  [(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'] and not(@CompileTimeConstant = true()))
    or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('format', 'formatted')]]
message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.info("user '{'}", user); '{'0} in System.Logger and java.util.logging), not a message built with + or String.format.

name: MutableStaticCollection
xpath:
//FieldDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final']
  [VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]]
  [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private' and VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListSet') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue')
      or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingDeque')])]
  [let $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return
    pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public'
    or ancestor::ClassBody[1]//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('add', 'addAll', 'put', 'putAll', 'putIfAbsent', 'remove', 'clear', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'offer', 'push', 'poll', 'pop', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'removeIf', 'replaceAll', 'sort')]
        [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name = $name]
        [ancestor::MethodDeclaration or ancestor::ConstructorDeclaration]]
message: Do not mutate a static collection or expose a mutable one. Build it once as an immutable List.of, Map.of or Map.copyOf, or keep the state in an instance.

name: MutationIgnoreMarker
xpath: //Annotation[@SimpleName = ('DoNotMutate', 'CoverageIgnore')]
message: Remove the annotation and kill the mutants with a test: PIT does not mutate code annotated @DoNotMutate or @CoverageIgnore.

name: NegatedOperands
xpath:
//InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')]
  [let $op := @Operator,
       $top := .,
       $chain := ($top, $top//InfixExpression[@Operator = $op]
         [every $between in (ancestor::* intersect $top/descendant::*)
          satisfies $between[self::InfixExpression][@Operator = $op]]),
       $operands := $chain/*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])]
   return not(parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])
     and (every $operand in $operands satisfies $operand[self::UnaryExpression][@Operator = '!'])]
message: Negate once: !a && !b is !(a || b), and !a || !b is !(a && b).

name: SwallowedInterrupt
message: This catch of InterruptedException can complete without rethrowing it or restoring the interrupt, so the interrupt status of the thread is lost and work that was asked to stop keeps running.

name: TaskOutlivesTryResource
xpath:
//MethodCall
  [@MethodName = ('submit', 'execute', 'schedule', 'scheduleAtFixedRate', 'scheduleWithFixedDelay')
      and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Executor')
        or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Timer')]
    or @MethodName = ('supplyAsync', 'runAsync')
      and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture')]
    or @MethodName = ('thenApplyAsync', 'thenAcceptAsync', 'thenRunAsync', 'thenComposeAsync',
                      'whenCompleteAsync', 'handleAsync')
      and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage')]
    or @MethodName = 'startVirtualThread' and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')]
    or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::ConstructorCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')]
    or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::MethodCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread.Builder')]]
  [let $s := .
   return some $block in ancestor::Block[parent::TryStatement[ResourceList]]
   satisfies
     (let $receiver := *[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name,
          $arguments := (ArgumentList/*, *[1][self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/*),
          $resources := $block/parent::TryStatement/ResourceList/Resource,
          $captured := $resources[
            let $name := (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name)
            return exists($arguments[self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodReference
                                     or self::ConstructorCall[AnonymousClassDeclaration]]
                            //VariableAccess[@Name = $name])
              or exists($arguments[self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $name])],
          $chain := $s/ancestor-or-self::MethodCall[
            every $step in ($s/ancestor::* intersect ./descendant::*) satisfies $step/self::MethodCall],
          $top := $chain[1],
          $holder := ($top/parent::VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name,
                      $top/parent::AssignmentExpression[*[2] is $top]/*[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name),
          $uses := $block//VariableAccess[@Name = $holder][. >> $s][not(parent::AssignmentExpression and . is ../*[1])],
          $waits := $block//MethodCall[. >> $s]
            [@MethodName = ('awaitTermination', 'close') and *[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver]
             or @MethodName = 'take' and *[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver]
                [pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService')]
             or @MethodName = 'poll' and ArgumentList[@Size = 2] and *[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver]
                [pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService')]
             or @MethodName = ('await', 'awaitAdvance', 'awaitAdvanceInterruptibly', 'arriveAndAwaitAdvance',
                               'acquire', 'acquireUninterruptibly')
                and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch')
                  or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier')
                  or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Phaser')
                  or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore')]]
            [every $region in ancestor::*[. >> $block]
                [self::CatchClause or self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration
                 or (parent::IfStatement or parent::ConditionalExpression or parent::SwitchStatement
                     or parent::SwitchExpression) and not(. is ../*[1])
                 or (parent::ForeachStatement or parent::ForStatement or parent::WhileStatement)
                    and . is ../*[last()]
                 or parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')] and . is ../*[2]]
             satisfies exists($region intersect $s/ancestor-or-self::*)]
      return exists($captured)
        and not(ancestor::*[self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration][. >> $block])
        and not($chain[@MethodName = ('get', 'join', 'getNow', 'resultNow', 'awaitTermination')])
        and ($top/parent::ExpressionStatement or $top/parent::ReturnStatement
             or (exists($holder) and (every $use in $uses satisfies $use/parent::ReturnStatement)))
        and (some $resource in $captured satisfies empty($resource/following-sibling::Resource[
               (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name) = $receiver]))
        and empty($waits))]
message: The task started by {0}() reads a resource of its try-with-resources, but nothing waits for it after it starts, unconditionally, before the block ends, so the resource is closed while the task can still run. Wait inside the block: get() or join() on the future, awaitTermination or close on the executor, take() or a timed poll() on its CompletionService, await() on a latch or barrier, or declare the executor as a later resource of the same try so it closes first and waits. Or open the resource inside the task.
